pages.text: Right-click to throw. Every thrown explosive has a 3 second cooldown. $(l)Thermite grenades On impact a thermite grenade explodes and throws $(item)20 sparks$() in every direction, each lighting a fire where it lands.$() The blast hurts creatures but $(item)does not break blocks$().

$(li)$(item)Thermite Grenade$() (4 thermite powder around an aluminium ingot): ordinary fire. $(li)$(item)Zinc Grenade$() (thermite grenade + 2 zinc ingots): $(item)green fire$(). $(li)$(item)Copper Grenade$() (thermite grenade + 2 copper ingots): $(item)blue fire$().$(br2)The coloured fires burn like normal fire and give full light.

$(l)Pipe Bomb$()$(br)A Steel Pipe and TNT make two. It is thrown much further than a grenade and explodes on impact, again without breaking blocks. A good choice against mobs near your factory, where you do not want craters.
